logp.method_description: Complexes 1–3 were carried out their lipophilicity by traditional shake flask method was used as an experimental technique in buffer 7.4 and 1-octanol. Calibration graphs of absorbance against concentrations of these complexes in these two solvents were shown Fig. S13. The 2.0 mg of complexes 1–3 with 1:1 ratio of phosphate buffer pH 7.4: 1-octanol (25:25 mL) were prepared and shaken (500 rpm) in 1-octanol-saturated phosphate buffer (pH 7.4) for 72 h. Each layer of buffer 7.4 and 1-octanol were separated by separatory funnel. Absorbance of each complex at 361 nm of each partition was measured and determined its concentration from the calibration graphs. lipophilicity index (log Pow) was evaluated from the equation of log Pow = log (Ao/Aw); Ao and Aw are each complex’s absorbance in 1-octanol and phosphate buffer 7.4 partitions, respectively.
